provenance.operator: Metric stress minimization of shortest-path distances on the shared-descendant concept graph
provenance.membershipConstruction: Research Areas concepts directly assigned to each active discipline; SKOS narrower/broader descendant closure; no embeddings or paper counts.
provenance.coordinateTransform: Rigid PCA orientation/sign fixing; uniform per-component scaling and deterministic disconnected-component packing.
provenance.edgeLength: 1 / sqrt(cosine(binary descendant membership)); this monotone display construction has no empirical physics units.
provenance.optimization: SMACOF, classical initialization plus four fixed random starts, at most1500 iterations; selected minimum stress.

baselineDiffusionAgainstGraphDistance.neighborTieCaveat: Equal-distance ties use fixed source order; this graph metric is a display construction, not physics distance.

limitations: Vocabulary/classification overview, not empirical all-physics paper geometry.
Broad/narrow and shared-concept relations do not imply scientific dependence, truth or question equivalence.
Two dimensions distort the recorded membership geometry; diagnostics report within-component loss.
Between disconnected components, grid spacing is display packing only.
Coordinates cannot be compared with the separate Swampland source-geometry chart.
Discipline concept counts reflect taxonomy granularity, not research volume or importance.
Graph-distance layout is a browsing aid; edge-length mapping and 2D fit can change visible proximity without changing classification memberships.
